```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
library(ISLR2)
library(MASS)
```

```{r}
data("Carseats")
attach(Carseats)
```

```{r}
view(Carseats)
```

```{r}
dim(Carseats)
```
```{r}
str(Carseats)
```
```{r}
?Carseats
```

```{r}
model=lm(Sales~Price+Urban+US,data = Carseats)
```

```{r}
summary(model)
```
```{r}
coef(model)
```
```{r}
model_2=lm(Sales~Price+US,data=Carseats)
summary(model_2)
```
```{r}
coef(model_2)
```
